LanguageData.Gun_Luger_P08_RWP.description: A classic semi-automatic pistol, the Luger P08 combines historical charm with reliable performance. It features a toggle-lock mechanism and a modest magazine capacity, suitable for mid-range engagements. Its precision and craftsmanship make it a collector's favorite, though it may not match the stopping power of more modern firearms.
